title: Tucker Tower
address:
9910 Hibiscus St
Miami, Florida 33157
United States
description:
Tucker Tower is a $44 million, eight-story affordable housing community for seniors 62 and older in the Palmetto Bay/Perrine area of Miami-Dade County. Housing Trust Group and AM Affordable Housing, the firm former NBA player Alonzo Mourning founded, built it together as their fifth joint project. The 120 one- and two-bedroom apartments run from 601 to 895 square feet, with six units built fully accessible and three set up for residents who are hearing impaired, alongside lighted pathways throughout the property.

Residents have access to a pool, a fitness center, a multi-purpose theater room, a library, a business center with computer stations, and a pet grooming station.
